# PROCESS — cand_0006 (parent cand_0005, current champion, val 0.604)

Method reconfirmed from LEDGER/JOURNAL: the adapter recalculates output with LibreOffice, so
standard formulas DO recalc and pass. "Prefer literals over formulas" is REFUTED globally
(cand_0001). The independent/adversarial VERIFY rewrite of task_template step 3 is REFUTED
(cand_0002, unbounded blast radius, broke 4 tasks) — so although circular self-verification is the
dominant meta-pattern across ~all failing traces, I do NOT re-touch the verify step. All three
edits below are ADDITIVE and conditionally-scoped; each extends a lever the gate already ACCEPTED
(the dynamic-array caveat, cand_0003) or fills a clean knowledge gap, and each is grep-verified to
change no currently-passing trajectory.

Diagnosis was fan-out: 4 read-only subagents covered ALL 36 failing traces; I then grep-checked the
55 passing traces' final code for the exact formula idioms my edits route away from, to confirm
blast radius empirically.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = # failing tasks × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Single-cell ARRAY-ENTERED (CSE) / `_xlfn` formula written as a plain string → grader returns BLANK/0 | 58890 (`MATCH(1,(a)*(b),0)`), 6698 (`SUM(COUNTIFS(...,{">","="}&0))` array constant), 55258 (`NUMBERVALUE`) | Agent computes the RIGHT value in Python, then writes a formula that needs Ctrl+Shift+Enter array entry; openpyxl saves it non-array so LibreOffice mis-evaluates it → 0. Existing caveat only names spilling/multi-cell arrays, missing single-cell CSE. | KNOWLEDGE/CONTRACT — extends the ACCEPTED cand_0003 dynamic-array caveat + resolves its conflict with the "extend the existing formula" rule |
| 2 | Date-dependent value asked for as a FORMULA → agent freezes a literal from a guessed date | 32023 (expected `=XLOOKUP(TODAY(),…)`; agent wrote frozen codes) | Current "today" guidance steers to a calibrated literal; but when a FORMULA is requested the expected stores a live TODAY() formula and the grader recalcs TODAY() on its own clock for both files → literal never matches. | KNOWLEDGE — narrowing carve-out on the existing "today" block |
| 3 | Count/sum over a column whose cells are FORMULAS → openpyxl default read returns formula TEXT | 47699 (count FALSE in a VLOOKUP column; regressed from PASS under cand_0003) | Agent counts with `data_only=False`, so VLOOKUP cells are formula strings, never counted → undercount that diverges on hidden files. | KNOWLEDGE — missing fact (data_only / write COUNTIF) |

## Edits kept (all in prompt.md; each additive/conditional; verify + blast-radius)
| # | cluster | edit | verify-the-fix | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1 | PRODUCE-THE-RESULT formula block: extended the recalc-unreliable list to single-cell CSE formulas (`MATCH(1,(a)*(b),0)`, in-line `{...}` array constants, `NUMBERVALUE`/`TEXTJOIN`/`_xlfn.*`), explained WHY (openpyxl saves formulas non-array), told the agent to rewrite as SUMPRODUCT(`--()`)/SUMIFS/INDEX-MATCH or a runtime-derived literal, and reconciled the conflict: this holds even when the answer cell already holds such an array formula and the task says "extend it". | 58890 trace: agent wrote `=IFNA(INDEX(…,MATCH(1,INDEX((col=a)*(col=b),0),0)),"")` and had already computed 0.4223… in Python; 6698: wrote `SUM(COUNTIFS(...,{...}))`, noted cached value was `None`, finished anyway (true count 2592); 55258: `SUMPRODUCT(...NUMBERVALUE...)` → blank (true 200). Edit routes all three to a recalc-safe rewrite or the literal they already computed. | BOUNDED. Grep of 55 passing traces: NO passing task writes `MATCH(1,`, an Excel `{...}` array constant, or `NUMBERVALUE`. SUMPRODUCT is explicitly kept as the RECOMMENDED recalc-safe idiom — passing 35747 & 50682 write `=SUMPRODUCT(--(...))` and pass 3/3, and are untouched. Extends an accepted lever, does not loosen any rule. |
| 2 | 2 | WRITE-GENERAL-CODE "today" block: added an EXCEPTION bullet — when a date-dependent value is requested as a FORMULA, write a live `TODAY()/NOW()` formula, not a frozen literal; worked note that a pinned-date example illustrates the formula's output, not a hardcode target. | 32023 trace: instruction asks for "a formula … based on today's date"; agent picked reference date 2024-01-05 and wrote literal codes C77/C76…; expected file stores `=XLOOKUP(TODAY(),D:L,$D$1:$L$1,"",-1)` which recalcs on the grader clock → literal fails all 3. Edit makes the agent emit the live formula. | BOUNDED. Grep: NO passing task writes `TODAY()`/`NOW()`; the bullet fires only when the instruction asks for a date-dependent FORMULA (not a value), so no passing value-task or calibrated-literal task changes. Additive carve-out, existing frozen-date guidance untouched. |
| 3 | 3 | WRITE-GENERAL-CODE read bullet: when counting/summing over cells that are FORMULAS, openpyxl default returns formula TEXT and undercounts — write the aggregate as a recalc formula (`COUNTIF`/`SUMIF`/`COUNTA`) or re-open with `data_only=True`. | 47699 trace: agent looped `ws.cell(r,1).value` (default load) over a VLOOKUP column checking `is False`/`=="FALSE"`; formula cells are strings → skipped → wrong D1 count on all 3. Edit routes it to `=COUNTIF(A:A,FALSE)` / `data_only=True`. | BOUNDED. Fires only when aggregating over FORMULA cells; the recommended COUNTIF/SUMIF/COUNTA are standard recalc-safe formulas. Passing count/sum tasks over plain-value columns are unaffected (their literals stay correct); no passing trace relies on reading formula text for an aggregate. |

## ENVIRONMENT / non-prose-fixable — flagged, NOT edited
- **34-5**: CONFIRMED LibreOffice sheet-rename infra fault — its scorer range `A8:L30` is the ONLY
  feedback range in the whole set with no `'Sheet'!` qualifier (sheet `SHEET1` renamed on recalc);
  correct deletions still score 0. A human must fix the recalc sheet-rename. No prompt edit applies.
- **4225**: pure-text Green/"Non Green" task whose output exactly matches the instruction's own
  worked example yet scores 0/3 including the visible file — grading/env fault, not the agent's.
- **53062**: 48,610-row × 133-col formula-dense workbook; logically-correct `IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH…))`
  fix returns blank — most likely a recalc-scale/env limit, low-confidence, not safely prose-fixable.

## Deliberately skipped (interpretation variance / no safe GENERAL rule)
- Ambiguous gold / idiosyncratic reference-macro behavior, not derivable from the visible file:
  53449, 55039, 55912, 58484, 585-41, 32468, 32975, 347-49, 398-14 (sign/hyphen), 413-15 (NET
  derivation), 39946 & 45944 (heterogeneous multi-section answer ranges), 146-49 (output ordering +
  column convention), 269-44 (buggy VBA cascade), 30930, 49782, 50526, 53305, 157-4, 250-20 (dup
  edge case).
- 267-18 (prefix placement) & casing (10281 wants "Pass" from instruction vs 50486 wants "CHEP"
  from sheet — mutually CONTRADICTORY, so no single safe rule): skipped, would regress the other.
- 14207 ("highlight is illustrative, derive the rule"): a general "ignore highlights" rule is
  UNBOUNDED — it would flip 267-18 and every passing color-detection task where the color IS the
  criterion. No safe discriminator; skipped.
- 50755: cand_0005's "reproduce each cell's own formula pattern" text (lines 47-49) arguably
  mis-steered it, but that text is recently-ACCEPTED global wording; rewriting it is unbounded and
  the gold reading is genuinely ambiguous — left alone.

## Deliberately NOT re-tried (prior RESULTS refuted these — never re-test)
- "Prefer literals over formulas" globally (cand_0001) — my Edit 1 is the NARROW single-cell-CSE
  slice only, and it actively steers toward recalc-safe formulas (SUMPRODUCT) first.
- Independent/adversarial VERIFY rewrite of task_template step 3 (cand_0002, REJECTED) — the
  circular-verify meta-pattern is real but this lever is refuted and unbounded; not re-touched.
- Global no-embellishment block (cand_0002, broke 4); cand_0004's whole batch (net-zero). Not re-added.

## Process & features used
- 4 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents (general-purpose) over all 36 failing traces, then a
  scripted grep over all 55 passing traces' final code to verify blast radius empirically. All three
  edits applied serially in this one candidate (no worktree merge needed). task_template.md left
  UNCHANGED — all three fixes belong in the system prompt's grading-contract / knowledge sections.
